messages:
Elaine: Quick async check — the pricing/packaging change landing Tue touches metering hooks + quota mapping. Need owners for: metering schema updates, billing mapping, quota enforcement, and legal contract wording. Tagging owners, pls state current blocker and ETA. TL;DR: we need a production-safe rollout plan by EOD Fri. @Ravi @Juniper @Sam @Nora :eyes:
Ravi: I can take billing-mapping. Which repos are in-scope? billing-adapter or rate-limiter? Also point me to the PR that changes the event shape so I can wire fallback logic.
Juniper: Metering side — change adds `plan_override` to hook payload. Schema PR: https://github.com/redwood/metering/pull/492. Main blocker: metering-proxy (relay) needs a tiny deserial change; I can do it but need 2-3h for smoke tests across envs. ETA EOD Mon (tomorrow). :thumbsup:
Sam: Billing: we need sku->plan mapping updated. Current join uses `product_code` and will break when `plan_override` is present. If Ravi owns mapping, add fallback: prefer `plan_override` when present, else `product_code`. Also, are we changing quota buckets? If yes billing needs a migration plan.
Ravi: Got it — I'll add fallback logic in billing-adapter. Quotas: not changing bucket ids, only semantics for how packaging counts toward bucket (might increase `used_tokens`). I'll open an umbrella PR linking metering PR and adapter changes. ETA tomorrow morning.
Nora: Legal: clause 4.b (invoice rounding) is okay as-is, but we need clear consumer-facing wording around bundled pricing and TOS updates. Also flag: any change that affects invoice format triggers a billing audit. Sam pls confirm audit window.
Sam: Confirmed — invoice audit will run post-rollout, may add ~24h to post-rollout checks. Also seeing a failing test in billing-adapter CI on current branch, snippet below. @Ravi can you take a look?
deploy-bot: CI failed in billing-adapter (tests/invoice_rounding_test.py::test_bundle_rounding) — log: AssertionError: expected 1.23 but got 1.24 (see: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/8932)
Ravi: Looking now — likely test expectation needs update per new rounding rules. If it's only test, will fix and push.
Elaine: Action items capture: 1) Juniper — metering-proxy PR + smoke tests (ETA TOM) 2) Ravi — umbrella mapping PR, update tests (ETA TOM AM) 3) Sam — invoice audit runbook + confirm migration window (ETA EOD) 4) Nora — TOS wording + ops/compliance notification (ETA EOD). I'll collate into rollout doc after ack. Reply 'ack' when accepted.
Juniper: ack
Ravi: ack — starting now
Sam: ack, will ping ops and schedule audit run
Nora: ack, will cc compliance and draft wording
Elaine: Thanks all — I'll update the rollout checklist. If any blocker beyond TOM AM escalate to #incidents.
